title: LSU releases exclusive interview with head basketball coach Will Wade on LSU+
text:
LSU releases exclusive interview with head basketball coach Will Wade on LSU+
LSU announced on June 24 that an exclusive interview featuring Head Basketball Coach Will Wade is now available for streaming on LSU+. The conversation, conducted by Chris Blair, Voice of the Tigers, covers Wade's return to Baton Rouge and his outlook for the men's basketball program.
The interview offers insights from Wade, who is referred to as "The General," as he discusses his plans and vision for the team. According to LSU, this content is only accessible through its streaming platform.
Viewers interested in watching the full discussion are encouraged to subscribe to LSU+. The announcement also includes a promotional offer allowing new subscribers to receive a discount by using a specific code during registration.
Wade's return and comments come at a time when fans are looking forward to developments within the basketball program. The university continues its efforts to engage supporters through exclusive digital content and special subscription incentives.
The release concludes with information about how fans can access both the interview and ongoing coverage of LSU athletics via its official streaming service.
